product_one_liner.value: Malachyte provides real-time AI personalization of search, recommendations and merchandising for e-commerce brands and retailers, adapting experiences to each shopper’s behavior and intent.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or pricing navigation was found; the commercial call to action is to book a demo.

eng_blog.notes: Technical articles include a two-headed transformer/shared-vector architecture explanation by technical co-founder Sidd Motwani and an infrastructure deep dive co-authored with Staff Machine Learning Engineer Vicki Boykis; the latter is hosted on Google Cloud and linked from the company blog.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers page states: “There are no open positions right now. Check back soon.”

model_provider.value: Malachyte’s proprietary Vector AI (two-headed transformer model)
model_provider.notes: The company names its own model/engine; no external LLM provider was identified in the reviewed documentation, blog, privacy policy or subprocessor list. Google Cloud is identified as infrastructure, not as its model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The technology page explicitly claims GDPR compliance. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 references in the DPA concern hosting infrastructure, not Malachyte-held certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The $10 million seed round was announced on 2026-08-06, within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official careers page states that there are no open positions.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 6, 2026 report states that the product became generally available to Shopify merchants through a native integration in June 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Malachyte announced Alex Khan joining as VP of Sales on June 17, 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Reviewed integration documentation names Shopify and infrastructure components, but no CRM or sales/marketing system used by Malachyte; the careers page has no open job descriptions.
